title: Beyond the Mainframe
handle_with_care: Teams work on a SYNTHETIC environment: workloads, cost data, logs and expert scenarios. No client systems, no client data. Practitioner mentors contribute knowledge throughout the event.
licence_note: Sources not listed under 'mirrored' are NOT redistributed by us. Use the loader code in the repo to fetch them from the original publisher.

tables.name: workload_cost_daily
tables.description: Synthetic workload cost and utilisation by day, across a hybrid mainframe, on-premises and cloud estate.

columns.name: workload_id
columns.description: Stable workload identifier, WL-nnnnn.

columns.name: usage_date
columns.description: Usage day, ISO-8601.

columns.name: business_unit
columns.description: Owning business unit. UNALLOCATED where ownership is untagged — this is deliberate and is a finding, not a defect.

columns.name: service
columns.description: Billable service, e.g. CICS Transaction Server, Kubernetes Service.

columns.name: platform
columns.description: One of mainframe, distributed, cloud.

columns.name: environment
columns.description: One of production, staging, development, test.

columns.name: region
columns.description: Deployment region or on-premises site.

columns.name: vcpu_hours
columns.description: Compute consumed that day, vCPU-hours (MIPS-equivalent on mainframe).

columns.name: memory_gb_hours
columns.description: Memory consumed that day, GB-hours.

columns.name: storage_gb
columns.description: Provisioned storage, GB. Flat per workload.

columns.name: utilisation_pct
columns.description: Mean utilisation that day, 0–100.

columns.name: cost_gbp
columns.description: Billed cost that day, GBP. Sums exactly to chargeback_allocation.

tables.name: chargeback_allocation
tables.description: Monthly cost allocation and chargeback by business unit and service. A pure roll-up of workload_cost_daily.
tables.grain: One row per business unit × month × service

columns.name: business_unit
columns.description: Owning business unit, or UNALLOCATED.

columns.name: month
columns.description: First day of the month, ISO-8601.

columns.name: service
columns.description: Billable service.

columns.name: workload_count
columns.description: Distinct workloads contributing that month.

columns.name: allocated_cost_gbp
columns.description: Allocated cost, GBP. Reconciles exactly to workload_cost_daily.

columns.name: share_of_bu_pct
columns.description: This service as a percentage of that business unit's spend that month.

columns.name: variance_vs_prior_month_pct
columns.description: Change on the previous month, percent. NULL in the first month a combination appears — absent, not zero.

tables.name: carbon_by_workload
tables.description: Estimated carbon per workload per day. Grid intensity is SYNTHETIC — realistic in shape, not a measurement.

columns.name: workload_id
columns.description: Stable workload identifier, joins to workload_cost_daily.

columns.name: usage_date
columns.description: Usage day, ISO-8601.

columns.name: business_unit
columns.description: Owning business unit, or UNALLOCATED.

columns.name: platform
columns.description: One of mainframe, distributed, cloud.

columns.name: energy_kwh
columns.description: Estimated energy for that workload-day, kWh.

columns.name: grid_intensity_gco2_per_kwh
columns.description: SYNTHETIC grid carbon intensity, gCO2e/kWh. Do not report findings against the real grid.

columns.name: carbon_kg
columns.description: Estimated emissions, kgCO2e = energy_kwh × intensity ÷ 1000.

usage.duckdb: INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs; SELECT * FROM read_parquet('https://data.inno-forum.co.uk/c03-beyond-the-mainframe/v1/gold/<table>.parquet');
usage.note: No credentials. No account. Anonymous HTTPS.
